source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 28 exercise hal (PDF 183-185): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short aur descriptive model jawab, Rf aur GC % ka hisaab qadam ba qadam, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 28 (Chromatography) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response (chromatograms ke hisaab ke saath) aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key aur hisaab ke jawab nahi chhape; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) Why must the solvent level be below the spot of the dye?
(Solvent ki satah dye ke spot se neeche kyun honi chahiye?)

options.text: To prevent the dye from dissolving directly into the solvent

blocks.explanation: Agar spot solvent ke andar ho to dye kaghaz par upar chadh kar alag hone ki bajaye seedha tank ke solvent mein ghul jaye gi (28.2).

blocks.prompt:
II) Why do some components of a dye travel further up the paper than others?
(Dye ke kuch hisse kaghaz par doosron se zyada upar kyun jate hain?)

options.text: They are more soluble in the water trap in paper (stationary phase)
They are more soluble in the solvent (mobile phase)

blocks.explanation: Jo hisse solvent (mobile phase) mein zyada ghulte hain woh zyada upar jate hain; jo kaghaz mein phanse paani (stationary phase) mein behtar ghulte hain woh zyada door nahi jate (28.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) mein 'the water trap in paper' chhapa hai; matlab 'water trapped in the paper' (kaghaz mein phansa paani) hai.

blocks.prompt:
III) A substance has a very low Rf value. What does this indicate?
(Kisi substance ki Rf value bohat kam ho to is ka kya matlab hai?)

options.text: It is insoluble in the solvent
It is highly soluble in the solvent
It strongly sticks to the water inside paper

blocks.explanation: Rf = substance ka tay kiya faasla / solvent ka tay kiya faasla. Kam Rf ka matlab hai ke woh bohat kam chala kyunke kaghaz ka paani (stationary phase) use mazbooti se rokta hai (us mein zyada ghulta hai) (28.2).

blocks.prompt:
IV) Which statement best explains adsorption?
(Adsorption ki behtareen wazahat kaun sa bayan karta hai?)

options.text: Substance sticks only to the surface of another material

blocks.explanation: Adsorption satah ka amal hai jis mein zarrat sirf bahar ki satah par jama hote hain, misal activated charcoal gases ko apni satah par pakadta hai (28.1).

blocks.prompt:
V) A polar compound in TLC will usually:
(TLC mein polar compound aam tor par kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polar substances polar stationary phase (alumina ya silica) ki taraf zyada khinchte hain aur zyada adsorb hote hain, is liye aahista chalte hain aur baseline ke qareeb rehte hain (28.3).

blocks.prompt:
VI) Why is TLC considered faster than paper chromatography?
(TLC ko paper chromatography se tez kyun mana jata hai?)

options.text: It has a solid stationary phase that allows quicker separation

blocks.explanation: TLC mein alumina ya silica ki patli thos teh stationary phase hai jo adsorption aur solubility dono se alag karti hai aur paper chromatography se tez hai (28.3, 28.5).

blocks.prompt:
VII) What is the role of the carrier gas in gas chromatography?
(Gas chromatography mein carrier gas ka kya kaam hai?)

options.text: To carry vaporized sample through the column

blocks.explanation: Carrier gas (helium ya nitrogen jaisi inert gas) mobile phase hai; yeh sample ke bukharat (vapours) ko column mein se le jati hai (28.4).

blocks.prompt:
VIII) Why must the stationary phase in GC have a high boiling point?
(GC mein stationary phase ka boiling point zyada kyun hona chahiye?)

options.text: To remain in liquid form during the process

blocks.explanation: Stationary phase silica ya alumina ke zarrat par laga non-volatile, zyada boiling point wala maaya hai. Garam column mein ise maaya hi rehna hai, bukharat ban kar carrier gas ke saath beh nahi jana (28.4).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri do options dono ko c) likha hai; chautha option 'To react with gases' d) hona chahiye. Jawab pehla c), 'To remain in liquid form during the process', hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX) What does the area under a peak in a chromatogram indicate?
(Chromatogram mein peak ke neeche ka area kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har peak ka area mixture mein us hisse ki miqdar (tanasub) batata hai; peak ka area = ½ × base × height (28.4).

blocks.prompt:
X) If two peaks have similar base width but different heights, how can composition be estimated?
(Agar do peaks ki base width barabar ho lekin height mukhtalif, to composition kaise andaza karenge?)
blocks.explanation: Jab peaks bohat patle hon ya un ki base width barabar ho to area ki jagah peak height se hisson ka tanasub andaza kiya jata hai (28.4).

blocks.prompt:
a) What is the principle of paper chromatography?
Paper chromatography ka usool kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Partition (nisbati solubility): sample ke hisse stationary phase (kaghaz ke cellulose mein phansa paani) aur mobile phase (solvent) ke darmiyan bat jate hain. Jo solvent mein zyada ghulte hain woh zyada upar jate hain, jo paani mein zyada ghulte hain woh kam; is tarah alag ho jate hain (28.2, 28.5).

blocks.prompt:
b) Why is pencil used instead of ink in chromatography to mark the basline?
Baseline lagane ke liye ink ki bajaye pencil kyun istemal hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Pencil (graphite) solvent mein nahi ghulti, is liye line apni jagah rehti hai. Ink khud dyes ka mixture hai; woh ghul kar solvent ke saath upar jaye gi aur izafi spots de gi jo sample ke spots mein mil jayenge.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein 'basline' chhapa hai; sahi lafz baseline hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) State two advantages of TLC over paper chromatography.
Paper chromatography ke muqable mein TLC ke do faide batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. TLC paper chromatography se tez hai.
2. Is ka thos stationary phase (silica ya alumina) adsorption aur solubility dono se alag karta hai, is liye alehdgi jaldi hoti hai; be-rang spots UV roshni ya iodine vapours se bhi dekhe ja sakte hain, sirf spray se nahi (28.3, 28.5).

blocks.prompt:
d) Why do polar substances move slowly in TLC?
TLC mein polar substances aahista kyun chalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase (alumina ya silica) polar hai. Polar substances is ki taraf zyada khinchte aur zyada adsorb hote hain, is liye aahista chalte hain aur un ki Rf values kam hoti hain (28.3).

blocks.prompt:
e) Why is TLC not suitable for large-scale separation?
TLC bari miqdar ki alehdgi ke liye munasib kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: TLC mein patli teh par sirf thori si miqdar mein sample lagaya aur parkha ja sakta hai, is liye bari miqdar alag nahi ho sakti (28.3).

blocks.prompt:
f) What is the function of injector port in GC?
GC mein injector port ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Sample injector port mein dala jata hai jahan oven use foran bukharat (vapour) bana deta hai; phir yeh vapour carrier gas ke saath column mein jata hai (28.4).

blocks.prompt:
g) Why must samples be volatile in GC?
GC mein samples ka volatile hona kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: GC mein mobile phase gas hai, is liye sample ka gas (vapour) ki shakal mein hona zaroori hai taake column mein se guzar sake. Jo cheezen aasaani se bukharat nahi banteen, misal proteins aur polymers, un ka tajzia nahi ho sakta (28.4).

blocks.prompt:
h) State two limitations of gas chromatography.
Gas chromatography ki do hudood (limitations) batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. GC sirf volatile (aasaani se bukharat banne wali) cheezon ke liye kaam karti hai.
2. Sample ko garmi bardasht karni chahiye; jo compounds zyada temperature par toot jayen woh istemal nahi ho sakte. (Aalaat aur maintenance bhi mehnge hain.) (28.4)

blocks.prompt:
i) What information does a chromatogram provide?
Chromatogram kya maloomat deta hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Peaks ki tadaad hisson (components) ki tadaad batati hai.
2. Har peak ka retention time hissa pehchanne mein madad deta hai.
3. Har peak ka area (ya height) mixture mein us hisse ka tanasub batata hai (28.4).

blocks.prompt:
j) What is adsorption? Give one example.
Adsorption kya hai? Aik misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Adsorption satah ka amal hai jis mein zarrat kisi doosri cheez ki sirf bahar ki satah par jama hote hain. Misal: activated charcoal gases aur gandagi ko apni satah par pakadta hai, is liye filters mein istemal hota hai (28.1).

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar banaye jane wale jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) A mixture of amino acids is analysed using thin layer chromatography. The chromatogram obtained is shown. The table shows some Rf values for different amino acids in the same solvent.
(Chromatogram: baseline at 0 cm, solvent front at 5.0 cm; spot A at about 3.55 cm and spot B at about 1.45 cm. Table of Rf values: alanine 0.40, glutamic acid 0.29, leucine 0.71, valine 0.61.)
I) Use the chromatogram and the Rf values to deduce the amino acid responsible for spot A and spot B.
ii) A second chromatogram of the same mixture is taken using a more polar solvent. Predict the effect on the Rf values of the amino acids. Explain your reasoning.
Chromatogram aur Rf values se spots A aur B ke amino acids pehchanein; zyada polar solvent ka asar batayein.
blocks.explanation:
I) Diya gaya: solvent ka faasla = 5.0 cm; spot A ≈ 3.55 cm; spot B ≈ 1.45 cm (scale se parha gaya)
Formula: Rf = substance ka tay kiya faasla / solvent ka tay kiya faasla
Spot A: Rf = 3.55 cm / 5.0 cm = 0.71 → leucine (Rf 0.71)
Spot B: Rf = 1.45 cm / 5.0 cm = 0.29 → glutamic acid (Rf 0.29)
ii) Rf values barh jayengi (spots baseline se zyada door jayenge). Amino acids polar hain, is liye zyada polar mobile phase mein behtar ghulte hain; polar solvent polar stationary phase par un se muqabla bhi karta hai, is liye woh kam ruktay hain aur solvent ke saath zyada upar jate hain (28.3). Is liye Rf values ka muwazna sirf aik hi solvent mein kiya jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rf nikalne ka tareeqa: baseline se spot ke beech tak ka faasla napein aur use baseline se solvent front tak ke faasle se taqseem karein. Rf ki koi unit nahi aur yeh hamesha 1 se kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Gas chromatography involves a stationary phase and a mobile phase.
a) Name a suitable substance that could be used for each phase.
b) A mixture of three organic compounds is separated by gas chromatography. The chromatogram obtained is shown below.
(Chromatogram: detector response against time/min, four peaks in order of time labelled ester A, ester B, ester C and ester D, marked 14, 25, 52 and 38 respectively; the peaks have similar base widths.)
I) Explain the meaning of the term retention time.
ii) Calculate the % of N in the mixture. Show your working.
GC ke phases ke liye munasib cheezen, retention time ka matlab, aur mixture ka % composition nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
a) Mobile phase: inert carrier gas jaise helium (ya nitrogen).
Stationary phase: non-volatile, lambi chain wala hydrocarbon maaya jis ka boiling point zyada ho, silica (SiO₂) ya alumina (Al₂O₃) ke chhote zarrat par laga hua (28.4).
b) I) Retention time woh waqt hai jo koi substance column se guzarne mein leta hai, injection se le kar detector par us ki peak aane tak. Aik jaisi conditions mein har substance ka apna retention time hota hai, is liye is se pehchan hoti hai (28.4).
ii) Peaks ki base width barabar hai, is liye area ki jagah peak height istemal ho sakti hai (28.4). Chhape hue numbers ko peaks ka nisbati size maan kar:
Diya gaya: A = 14, B = 25, C = 52, D = 38
Jama = 14 + 25 + 52 + 38 = 129
Formula: kisi hisse ka % = (us ki peak / tamam peaks ka jama) × 100
% A = 14/129 × 100 = 10.9 %
% B = 25/129 × 100 = 19.4 %
% C = 52/129 × 100 = 40.3 %
% D = 38/129 × 100 = 29.5 %
Sab se bara hissa ester C (40.3 %) aur sab se chhota ester A (10.9 %) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa b) mein 'three organic compounds' likha hai lekin chromatogram mein chaar peaks hain jin par ester A, B, C aur D likha hai; aur ii) mein '% of N' poocha hai jabke N naam ka koi hissa nahi. Upar har ester ka % nikala gaya hai, is liye jo bhi muraad ho woh parha ja sakta hai. Kitab nahi batati ke 14, 25, 52, 38 heights hain ya areas; base width barabar ho to nateeja aik hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) An unknown amino acid is analysed by thin-layer chromatography. Two chromatographs of the unknown amino acid and four reference amino acids, P, Q, R and S, are obtained using two different solvents. Identify the unknown amino acid. Justify your answer.
(Both plates: baseline 0 cm, solvent front 5.0 cm. Solvent 1: unknown about 1.7 cm, P about 0.75 cm, Q about 1.7 cm, R about 3.25 cm, S about 1.7 cm. Solvent 2: unknown about 3.75 cm, P about 1.1 cm, Q about 2.5 cm, R about 3.75 cm, S about 3.75 cm.)
Do solvents ke chromatograms se unknown amino acid pehchanein aur wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Unknown S hai.
Solvent 1: unknown spot (≈ 1.7 cm, Rf ≈ 1.7/5.0 = 0.34) Q aur S ke barabar hai, is liye yeh Q ya S ho sakta hai, P ya R nahi.
Solvent 2: unknown spot (≈ 3.75 cm, Rf ≈ 3.75/5.0 = 0.75) R aur S ke barabar hai, is liye yeh R ya S ho sakta hai, P ya Q nahi.
Sirf S ki Rf value dono solvents mein unknown ke barabar hai, is liye unknown amino acid S hai. Do solvents is liye lete hain ke aik solvent mein do cheezon ki Rf value aik jaisi ho sakti hai (solvent 1 mein Q aur S; solvent 2 mein R aur S).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Q3 ke hisson par a), 3. aur c) chhapa hai; doosra hissa '3.' asal mein b) hona chahiye. Us ke andar sub-parts phir a), b) se shuru hote hain aur numbering mein I) aur ii) mile hue hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe the principle and working of paper chromatography.
Paper chromatography ka usool aur tareeqa e kaar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Usool: partition, yani nisbati solubility. Kaghaz ka cellulose paani rakhta hai jo stationary phase hai; solvent mobile phase hai. Har hissa dono mein bat jata hai: jo solvent mein zyada ghule woh kaghaz par zyada upar jata hai, jo paani mein zyada ghule woh kam; is tarah hisse alag ho jate hain (28.2).
Tareeqa e kaar:
1. Chromatography paper ke neeche ke qareeb pencil se baseline lagayein.
2. Capillary tube se sample ka chhota sa spot baseline par lagayein.
3. Kaghaz ko munasib solvent wale tank mein is tarah rakhein ke solvent ki satah spot se neeche ho; tank ko dhakkan se band karein.
4. Solvent kaghaz mein upar chadhta hai; hisse is mein mukhtalif had tak ghulte hain aur mukhtalif faasle tak jate hain.
5. Jab solvent oopar ke qareeb pohnche to kaghaz nikaal kar solvent front ka nishan lagayein aur sukhayein.
6. Be-rang hisson ko locating agent spray kar ke nazar aane wala banayein.
7. Faasle naap kar har spot ki Rf nikalein:
Rf = substance ka tay kiya faasla / solvent ka tay kiya faasla (koi unit nahi)
8. Aik jaisi conditions (wohi solvent aur temperature) mein standard Rf values se muqabla kar ke hisse pehchanein.
Paper chromatography rangeen aur be-rang dono cheezen alag karti hai aur is mein mixture ki bohat thori miqdar lagti hai, misal patton ke rang (Figure 28.1).

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain the principle and working process of thin layer chromatography (TLC) in detail.
TLC ka usool aur tareeqa e kaar tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Usool: adsorption aur solubility dono. Stationary phase alumina (Al₂O₃) ya silica (SiO₂) ki patli thos teh hai; mobile phase maaya solvent hai. Polar substances polar thos ki taraf zyada khinchte aur zyada adsorb hote hain, is liye aahista chalte hain; non-polar substances non-polar solvent mein zyada ghulte hain aur zyada upar jate hain (28.3).
Tareeqa e kaar:
1. Alumina ya silica ko paani mein mila kar slurry banayein, glass slide par barabar phaila kar oven mein sukhayein taake safed thos teh ban jaye.
2. Neeche ke qareeb pencil se seedhi baseline lagayein; capillary tube se samples ke spots lagayein (aik se zyada samples lag sakte hain).
3. Slide ko chromatography tank ke solvent mein khara karein, baseline solvent se oopar ho; dhakkan se band karein.
4. Solvent upar chadhta hai; har hissa mukhtalif had tak adsorb aur hal hota hai, is liye hisse alag ho jate hain.
5. Solvent kaafi upar aa jaye to slide nikaal kar solvent front ka nishan lagayein aur sukhayein.
6. Be-rang spots dhoondein: ninhydrin spray amino acids ko jamni (purple) kar deta hai; kuch cheezen UV roshni mein chamakti hain; kuch iodine vapours se bhoori ho jati hain.
7. Rf values nikaal kar standard values se muqabla karein aur hisse pehchanein.
Istemal: na-maloom compounds ki pehchan, khalis-pan ki jaanch, reaction ki pesh raft dekhna, dawaon aur khane ki cheezon ki jaanch, aaludgi aur keera maar dawaon ka pata, aur forensic kaam.
Hudood: zyada tar qualitative; qareebi Rf wale compounds achhe alag nahi hote; sirf thori miqdar; nami, temperature aur safai se mutasir.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Describe the main components of gas chromatography.
Gas chromatography ke bunyadi hisse bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Gas chromatograph ke bunyadi hisse (Figure 28.5):
1. Carrier gas ki supply (mobile phase): helium ya nitrogen jaisi inert gas jo sample ke vapours ko column mein se le jati hai.
2. Injector port (injector oven mein): sample yahan dala jata hai aur foran bukharat ban jata hai, phir carrier gas use column mein le jati hai.
3. Column (column oven mein): lambi lapeti hui nali (1-5 m lambi, 3-6 mm qutr) jis mein bari satah wale silica ke chhote zarrat bhare hain, un par stationary phase, yani non-volatile, zyada boiling point wala lambi chain ka hydrocarbon maaya, laga hai. Yahan alehdgi hoti hai: jo cheezen stationary phase se zyada interact karti hain woh aahista chalti hain.
4. Detector (detector oven mein): column se nikalne wali alag shuda cheezon ko pehchanta hai aur har aik ka retention time record karta hai.
5. Recorder ya computer: signals ko graph par peaks ki shakal mein dikhata hai jise chromatogram kehte hain. Retention time se hissa pehchana jata hai aur peak area (½ × base × height) se us ka tanasub.
Phir gas exit se bahar nikal jati hai.

items: MCQs ke jawab: I b, II b, III c, IV b, V b, VI b, VII c, VIII c, IX a, X d.
Q3 ke jawab: spot A leucine, spot B glutamic acid; esters A 10.9 %, B 19.4 %, C 40.3 %, D 29.5 %; unknown amino acid S.
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ II(a) 'water trap', MCQ VIII do baar c), Q2(b) 'basline', Q3 numbering a), 3., c), Q3 '3.' mein 'three compounds' aur '% of N'.
